# DataTeams

> DataTeams is an AI-powered talent recruitment platform specializing in hiring data professionals through GenAI-driven matching and assessment.

DataTeams leverages generative AI and machine learning to streamline the recruitment of skilled data professionals. The platform combines company mission-driven hiring with AI-powered skill assessment and onboarding capabilities.

## Key Topics

- GenAI hiring
- talent recruitment
- data professionals
- AI-powered matching
- hiring platform
- AI skills assessment
- recruitment automation
- data talent
- onboarding
- company values
